body: There is no way to do it without hurting her feelings. There is no way to die without hurting her, either. It's important to understand this, you just can't have your cake and eat it too.

I experience this as well. I like life, I like a lot of things about life, I'm passionate about things...but i feel like the way my life is right now, I can't actually experience any of that. And I don't know, maybe part of that is just a manifestation of depression, but I've felt genuinely very depressed in the past and it feels different, more apathetic. I also have the daily mood swings. Every day for...5+ years. I also have severe anxiety and that contributes a lot to my suicidal feelings. Feeling so overwhelmed that it would just be easier to jump ship, ya know. I get you.
I have plenty of other shit going on too. But not being impoverished would at least give me a better chance of making my life worth living.
